evidence.summary: The US Commerce Department added it to the Entity List in April 2022 as “Tactical Missile Corporation, NPO Electromechanics”, a unit of the Tactical Missiles Corporation (KTRV), which the US Treasury calls a large, state-owned Russian defence conglomerate. OFAC lists it in Miass.
It belongs to the Tactical Missiles Corporation (KTRV), a Russian state-owned defence conglomerate.
